items.title: 'NYX' CROCODILE BELT WITH BLUE FLARE GUN
items.desc:
hi nyxxie 

just like the kindred spirits around the world, you assist where you can, the way you know how, for those closest to you that need it

flare guns are usually placed in situations where help is intrinsically harder, more limited to access - just like on a boat. as youve mentioned, the boat represents freedom, where nothing matters but the tiny world that is the boat; and yet, that freedom is not guaranteed every time because of the inherent dangers of boating. therefore, that pursuit of freedom is flawed, but can be ameliorated when precautions are met.

this blue flare gun represents the dichotomy between freedom, and the pursuit for freedom - with it, you are the savior amongst the people you boat with, the one call for help; and on the opposite end, a signifier that your freedom lies in what matters the most to you, the safety and wellbeing of those that you find sitting in the boat of your choosing.


happy birthday nyxxie


- love, soko
